artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan (re-measure, add four LIVE-UNPINNED KNOWN-ANCHORS rows, full invariant run with Reasoned Exclusions) to make check-module-invariants.sh report ALL CHECKS PASSED.

memory_candidates.content: When a task description ships a pre-computed classification of a failing gate's items (which anchors are live vs dangling, which files are affected), treat it as a hypothesis with a timestamp, not as input data. Re-run the failing check first and enumerate the live failure set before planning against the description: commits landing between task creation and dispatch routinely add members to the set (here a fourth anchor from a later commit) and resolve members the description called blocked (here a cross-repo coordination the description demanded had already landed). The plan-side carrier for this is a Scope Hypothesis line on the measuring phase, which makes the measured set authoritative over the report.
